channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Navi Pillay Awarded Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: The former UN human rights chief has received the Nobel Peace Prize. The Norwegian Nobel Committee cited her dedication to international law and peace as the reason for the honor.

item.title: United States Targets International Criminal Court with Sanctions
item.description: Washington has introduced new financial penalties against the tribunal. Officials stated the goal is to limit the operational capacity and financial resources of the court.

item.title: বিশ্ব ডিম দিবসে মস্তিষ্কের স্বাস্থ্য ও ডিমের ভূমিকা আলোচনা
item.description: ২০৬ সালের এক গবেষণায় প্রায় এক লাখ মানুষের তথ্য বিশ্লেষণ করে দেখা গেছে, ডিম খাওয়ার সঙ্গে মস্তিষ্কের বয়সজনিত পরিবর্তনের ইতিবাচক সংযোগ রয়েছে। বিশ্ব ডিম দিবসে মস্তিষ্কের সুস্থতা ও জটিল স্নায়বিক কার্যক্রমে ডিমের প্রভাব নিয়ে আলোচনা করা হয়।

item.title: মজুরি বোর্ড গঠনসহ চার দাবি গার্মেন্ট শ্রমিক সংহতির
item.description: রাজধানীর জাতীয় প্রেস ক্লাবে এক সমাবেশে প্রকৃত শ্রমিক প্রতিনিধি দিয়ে তৈরি পোশাকশিল্পের নিম্নতম মজুরি বোর্ড গঠনের দাবি জানানো হয়। বাংলাদেশ গার্মেন্ট শ্রমিক সংহতির পক্ষ থেকে গণতান্ত্রিক শ্রম বিধিমালা, ট্রেড ইউনিয়ন নিবন্ধন সহজীকরণ ও অসৎ শ্রম আচরণ বন্ধের দাবিও জানানো হয়।

item.title: Tesla Rebrands Driver Software in Europe
item.description: Tesla has updated the name of its driver assistance software to Tesla Assisted Driving within the European market. Following this update, Germany's transport minister urged the rest of Europe to approve the software.

item.title: বাংলাদেশ ট্যাক্স লইয়ার্স অ্যাসোসিয়েশনের নতুন কমিটি গঠিত
item.description: বাংলাদেশ ট্যাক্স লইয়ার্স অ্যাসোসিয়েশনের ২০২৬-২৯ মেয়াদের নতুন কমিটিতে রমিজউদ্দিন আহমেদ সভাপতি ও মো. মাজম আলী খান মহাসচিব নির্বাচিত হয়েছেন। রাজধানীর ঢাকা ট্যাক্সেস বার হলরুমে অনুষ্ঠিত সংগঠনের ৩৯তম সাধারণ সভায় এই কার্যনির্বাহী কমিটি গঠন করা হয়।

item.title: Prime Minister Pledges to Restrict Non-Compete Clauses
item.description: The prime minister announced plans to limit post-employment restrictions in labor contracts. According to the leader, current limitations on post-departure employment have become excessive.

item.title: Orkut Creator Plans Platform Revival to Fight AI Content
item.description: The original creator of Orkut is working on relaunching the social network. The new initiative aims to counter the proliferation of artificial intelligence content and algorithmic feeds.

item.title: Montenegro arrests pro-Kremlin military blogger Mikhail Zvinchuk
item.description: Authorities in Montenegro have detained Mikhail Zvinchuk, founder of the pro-Kremlin Rybar blog. Officials stated the arrest follows warnings regarding efforts to destabilize the Balkan nation.

item.title: CAF considers keeping Africa Cup of Nations on a two-year cycle
item.description: The Confederation of African Football is currently reviewing the tournament's schedule. Discussions are underway to potentially cancel the planned transition to a four-year interval.

item.title: Jamaat asks DNCC administrator for proof of auto-rickshaw claims
item.description: Dhaka North City Corporation administrator Shafiqul Islam Khan claimed an inquiry showed Jamaat-e-Islami leader Mia Golam Porwar owns 700 auto-rickshaws. The party has dismissed the allegation as fiction and demanded proof.

item.title: Supreme Court on protests; INDIA Bloc to seek CEC resignation
item.description: The Supreme Court has upheld the rights of citizens to form associations and protest peacefully, requesting information on permissions for the October 10 demonstrations. Meanwhile, leaders of the opposition INDIA Bloc plan to meet the President at 8 p.m. to demand that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar step down.

item.title: India will reject monopolies across all industries, says Scindia
item.description: Minister Scindia stated that the government will prevent market monopolies in India. His remarks followed comments by SpaceX CEO Elon Musk regarding opposition to Starlink.

item.title: Vote tally starts for five assembly seats and one parliament seat
item.description: The outcomes for the Nandigram and Rejinagar by-elections in West Bengal may signal the region's current political climate following recent shifts.

item.title: A16z partner Olivia Moore discusses growth areas in consumer AI
item.description: Investor Olivia Moore believes consumer artificial intelligence holds significant potential. She emphasizes the importance of exploring monetization models outside of standard subscriptions and APIs.

item.title: অস্ট্রেলিয়ার ঘুরে দাঁড়ানো
item.description: প্রাথমিক ধসের পর অস্ট্রেলিয়া দলের রান সংগ্রহ সামাল দেন ম্যাট রেনশ ও প্যাট কামিন্স। ১২৪ রানে ৬ উইকেট পতনের পর তারা দলের বিপর্যয় এড়ান।

item.title: Verstappen secures Singapore Grand Prix sprint pole despite setup trouble
item.description: Red Bull driver Max Verstappen claimed sprint pole position for the Singapore Grand Prix. He edged out Mercedes competitor George Russell following earlier configuration difficulties.

item.title: High Court orders peaceful festival proceedings on Thiruparankundram hill
item.description: The High Court has instructed the Commissioner of Police to guarantee a peaceful celebration during the festival on Thiruparankundram hill.

item.title: Two Additional Arrests Made in Nileshwaram MDMA Case
item.description: Authorities have taken two more individuals into custody following the recent seizure of MDMA in Nileshwaram. Investigation into the drug confiscation remains ongoing.

item.title: Four Individuals Sentenced to Life in Prison for Murder
item.description: A court has handed down life imprisonment sentences to four people convicted in a homicide case. The ruling concludes the judicial proceedings regarding the killing.

item.title: Ethiopia Vows Self-Defense Following Eritrean Border Crossing
item.description: Ethiopian authorities stated they will protect their territory after Eritrean troops crossed the frontier. Observers noted transport trucks carrying soldiers into Ethiopia alongside reported drone attacks.

item.title: P. Sathyabama Wins Dharapuram Seat by 9,471 Votes Against DMK
item.description: TVK candidate P. Sathyabama secured victory in Dharapuram, defeating her DMK opponent with a margin of 9,471 votes. She stated the outcome reflects public support for the TVK-led administration.

item.title: Timetable Released for UG NEET Stray Vacancy Round
item.description: The schedule for the undergraduate medical entrance test stray vacancy round has been officially published. Eligible candidates can now review the dates for the upcoming seat allocation process.

item.title: Sanitation Employees Resume Duties
item.description: Conservancy workers have gone back to their regular jobs. Municipal sanitation services are returning to normal operations following their return.

item.title: KSRTC Outlines Measures to Secure Senior Citizen Seat Reserves
item.description: Transport officials discussed allocating 20 percent of bus seating for elderly passengers, implementing online booking options, and giving conductors authority to fine rule-breakers. Additional proposals include lowering step heights and shifting seat locations.

item.title: TVK Secures Madurantakam and Dharapuram in Tamil Nadu Bypolls
item.description: The TVK party won both the Madurantakam and Dharapuram assembly seats in recent by-elections. These votes were triggered after the previous legislators, who initially won on AIADMK tickets in 2026, resigned and joined the ruling party.

item.title: Gauhati High Court approves bail for Amritprava Mahanta
item.description: The Gauhati High Court has approved a fifty thousand rupee bail for Amritprava Mahanta in the Zubeen Garg death investigation. This marks the initial release on bail connected to the fatal scuba diving incident involving Garg.

item.title: Malaysia arrests twenty individuals over worker quota scam
item.description: Malaysian immigration authorities have taken twenty people into custody on allegations of foreign worker quota fraud. The detained group includes eleven citizens from Bangladesh.

item.title: HMDA mortgages ten land tracts to secure infrastructure funds
item.description: The HMDA has mortgaged ten land parcels to secure ten billion rupees for infrastructure projects. The capital will fund two greenfield radial roads and two elevated corridors.

item.title: West Bank olive harvest disrupted by Israeli settler raids
item.description: Nineteen separate settler assaults targeted the Palestinian olive harvest in the West Bank on Friday. Concurrently, Israeli military personnel arrested sixteen Palestinians during separate operations.

item.title: Everton put up for sale by current owners TFG
item.description: Football club Everton has been listed for sale once more by its owners, The Friedkin Group. The decision initiates a new ownership search process for the club.

item.title: India sets record T20I score against West Indies in Ranchi
item.description: India achieved their highest T20I total against the West Indies by scoring 249 runs in Ranchi. Sanju Samson led the innings with an 82-run knock from 41 deliveries.

item.title: Karnataka receives numerous voter list objections during SIR
item.description: Karnataka election authorities gathered over 110,000 Form 7 objection applications. These filings contest proposed additions or removals of names during the ongoing electoral roll revision.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias reaches Category 3 strength approaching US
item.description: Hurricane Isaias has intensified into a Category 3 storm as it approaches the United States. The severe weather system is projected to hit the US Gulf Coast.

item.title: Karnataka Honored for Leading 9 GW Wind Energy Projects
item.description: Karnataka has received an accolade recognizing its achievement in reaching nine gigawatts of wind power generation capacity currently under development.

item.title: Madurai Municipal Authority Introduces Comprehensive Street Guidelines
item.description: The municipal administration of Madurai has officially rolled out a new framework focused on complete street design and management.

item.title: KSRTC Schedules More Than 3,000 Extra Buses for Dasara
item.description: To accommodate festive travelers, KSRTC is adding over 3,000 special services alongside its regular fleet operations for the Dasara celebrations.

item.title: Vijayawada Arranges Forty Parking Zones for Dasara Festival
item.description: Authorities in Vijayawada have established forty specific parking locations to accommodate visitors arriving for the Dasara festivities.

item.title: Opposition Parties Demand Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner
item.description: An all-party meeting led by the Congress party has demanded the departure of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, accusing the election panel of bias toward the ruling party.

item.title: TMC Member Arrested Following Attack on CPIM Leader Home
item.description: West Bengal leader Suvendu Adhikari announced the arrest of a TMC member linked to the recent vandalism at the Kolkata residence of CPIM politician Bikash Ranjan Bhattacharya.

item.title: IIM Bangalore Secures 11th Spot Worldwide in Financial Times Ranking
item.description: The Financial Times has placed the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore at number eleven globally regarding the influence of its educational case studies.

item.title: Essex Departs With Batter Facing Court Over Rape Allegations
item.description: County club Essex has verified the departure of a batsman following his court appearance regarding two rape allegations filed in July.

item.title: Visakhapatnam Spy Probe Examines Base Photography Methods
item.description: Investigators are examining how an individual accused in an espionage matter managed to take pictures and video footage inside the Visakhapatnam Naval Base.

item.title: Congress Criticizes Administration Over Corporate Monopolies
item.description: Rahul Gandhi asserted that India requires fair market competition giving equal opportunities to all enterprises, criticizing the central government for fostering monopolies and crony capitalism.

item.title: CBI Delivers Notice at Punjab Chief Minister Aide's Home
item.description: The Central Bureau of Investigation has affixed a formal summons notice on the exterior wall of the residence belonging to the Punjab Chief Minister's Officer on Special Duty.

item.title: Opposition Submits Four-Point Demands to President Murmu
item.description: Rahul Gandhi announced that opposition leaders presented a memorandum to President Murmu and plan to approach the Supreme Court and Chief Justice Surya Kant.

item.title: Delhi Law Enforcement Tracks Potential Demonstration Attendees
item.description: Ahead of the October 10 protest at Jantar Mantar, police have established a database, monitored numerous social media groups, and contacted prospective participants at their residences.

item.title: Kerala Administration Plans Assembly Resolution on University Bill
item.description: The state government intends to introduce an assembly resolution asking for the Private Universities Bill to be returned pursuant to Article 201 provisions of the Constitution.

item.title: Jalahalli Cross Underpass Initiative Advances Following Visit
item.description: The construction of the Jalahalli Cross underpass received renewed momentum after an on-site evaluation conducted by the Chief Commissioner of the GBA.

item.title: INDIA Bloc Delegation Petitions President for Official's Resignation
item.description: Following a parliamentary gathering, 150 MPs from the opposition alliance marched to deliver a memorandum signed by 16 leaders, demanding the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar.

item.title: Brussels police deploy water cannons against anti-austerity protesters
item.description: Law enforcement in Brussels used tear gas and water cannons after face-masked demonstrators turned violent during an anti-austerity demonstration.

item.title: Kerala High Court orders CBI investigation into violinist Balabhaskar's death
item.description: Criticizing the previous investigation as careless, the Kerala High Court instructed the CBI to pursue a deeper inquiry into the 2018 crash that killed the musician and his toddler.

item.title: Future vehicle technology could feature solar power and autonomous driving
item.description: Rapid advancements in the automotive sector suggest that automobiles a decade from now will likely incorporate solar panels, autonomous capabilities, and inter-vehicle communication.

item.title: California senior cycles 3,200 miles to support child hunger charity
item.description: Over a span of 69 days, 73-year-old Mark Strauss pedaled 3,200 miles to benefit the No Kid Hungry campaign, collecting $740,000 toward his million-dollar goal.

item.title: Premier League managers comment following Manchester City rule violations
item.description: Managers from rival clubs including Arsenal, Liverpool, and Manchester United shared their perspectives after Manchester City faced Premier League infractions.

item.title: বাংলাদেশের প্রথম দিনের সংগ্রহ ৮ উইকেটে ৩১৭ রান
item.description: ম্যাচের প্রথম দিন শেষে বাংলাদেশ দল আট উইকেটের বিনিময়ে মোট ৩১৭ রান সংগ্রহ করতে সক্ষম হয়েছে।

item.title: Rahul Gandhi predicts current administration will collapse amid CEC protests
item.description: Speaking to opposition lawmakers, Rahul Gandhi argued that ongoing demonstrations against the Chief Election Commissioner signal a broader crisis that will topple the government.

item.title: United States imposes sanctions directly on the International Criminal Court
item.description: In an escalation aimed at restricting the tribunal's resources, the US government has targeted the International Criminal Court with fresh sanctions.

item.title: Iran Guards hit LPG tanker in Hormuz over unauthorized path
item.description: On Friday, Iran's Revolutionary Guards reported intercepting a liquefied petroleum gas vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. Authorities stated the ship was navigating via an unlawful path.

item.title: মারেসকার আস্থাশীল দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি ও আপিল জয়ের বিশ্বাস
item.description: মারেসকা আজ এক সংবাদ সম্মেলনে জানান যে ক্লাবটির ওপর তাঁর পূর্ণ আস্থা রয়েছে। তিনি দৃঢ়ভাবে বিশ্বাস করেন যে আসন্ন আপিলে তারা বিজয়ী হবে।
